title: Type editor descriptor, contract version 1
description: What the panel's forms render a type from (PRD 11.12, 14.1, GUARDRAILS 2.4): the type's name, labels, capabilities and inferred title field, and its field tree as a flat list in form order, each field with its type and base, labels, presence, classification, agents flag, the choices of a select, how a group repeats, and its value rule in the form of the generated validation runtime. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Contracts\Editors\TypeEditor, compiled by cms:generate into the application's TypeEditors, and the generated codec TypeEditorCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace. The queries type.list and type.describe answer with it, filtered to the reader.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the type declares (PRD 3.1, 5, 10.1), so a form knows whether the type has stages to release and routes to give.

description.description: What the type holds, as its blueprint describes it, or null.

extensions.description: The extenders of the type, sorted by namespace, each with the version of its extension; the fields each adds are under ext.<namespace> among the fields.

fields.description: The field tree as a flat list in form order: the owner's top-level fields in blueprint order, each group followed by the fields below it, then each extender's fields the same way, by namespace. A nested field names its group's path as parent, and every group comes before the fields below it.

id.description: The id of the type, a UUIDv7, which never changes.

label.description: The label of the type, as its blueprint gives it.

name.description: The name of the type, <owner>:<handle>, such as app:blog_post.

title_field.description: The path of the field a form shows an entry by: the first required text field of the owner in blueprint order, else the owner's first text field, or null when the owner has no text field.

version.description: The owner's version of the type.

capabilities.description: The capabilities a type declares in its blueprint.

history.description: How much of the type's history is kept: every revision, the audit trail only, or nothing.

localization.description: How the type is localized (PRD 10.1): none, one shared variant with every field, or variants, a variant per language that holds the translatable fields and the shared variant that holds the others.

routable.description: Whether the type's entries have routes.

stages.description: Whether the type's entries have stages: none, or a draft that is released.

extension.description: An extender of the type and the version of its extension.

namespace.description: The extender's namespace, the owner that added the fields, such as app.

choice.description: One option of a select field: the value the field stores and its label.

label.description: The label of the option, as its blueprint gives it.

value.description: The value the field stores, a handle.

repeat.description: How a repeated group repeats: the fewest and the most items the form lets an editor add, each null when the blueprint leaves it out.

max_items.description: The most items, or null for the blueprint's default.

min_items.description: The fewest items, or null for none.

field.description: A field of the type as a form renders it: one input, and its value rule.

agents.description: Whether MCP tools and agents see the field (PRD 2.31, 12.2): a public or internal field unless its blueprint says no, a confidential field only when its blueprint says yes, never a personal or sensitive field.

base.description: The core field type whose form the value takes: the field type itself for a core field type, and the base of its shape for an addon's. A form picks its input by it.

choices.description: The options of a select, in the blueprint's order, each value once; empty for any other base.

classification.description: The classification of the field (PRD 12.2), which decides who may read it.

description.description: What the field holds, as its blueprint describes it, the help text of its input; or null.

encrypted.description: Whether the value is stored as ciphertext (PRD 12.2).

fallback.description: How a translatable field falls back when the reader's language has no value for it (PRD 10.3): with its whole variant, or on its own; variant for every field that is not translatable.

handle.description: The handle of the field, as the blueprint declares it.

label.description: The label of the field, as its blueprint gives it.

namespace.description: The extender's namespace for an extension field, which a nested field takes from its group; null for a field of the type's owner.

parent.description: The path of the group the field is nested in, which comes before it in the list, or null for a top-level field.

path.description: The address of the field: its handle for a top-level field of the owner, ext.<namespace>.<handle> for a top-level extension field, and the parent's path, a dot and the handle inside a group.

presence.description: What the generated validator requires: required at every write, required_on_release for an extension field the blueprint requires (PRD 11.12, point 1), else optional.

repeat.description: How a repeated group repeats, or null for a group that does not repeat and for any other base.

rule.description: The field's value rule in the form of the generated validation runtime, a ValueRule as the generated TypeScript module of the type's record declares it, so a form validates with the same interpreter; null for a group, whose object or list rule the form builds from the fields below it and repeat.

translatable.description: Which variant holds the field in a type with localization variants (PRD 10.1): a language's variant when true, so a form shows the field once per language, and the shared variant when false; always false in a type without localization. A nested field takes its group's.

type.description: The field type as the blueprint names it: a core field type such as text, or <namespace>:<handle> for a field type an addon contributes (PRD 13.1).
